chapter_summary: Song Tae-won and Sung Hyun-jae, a couple whose relationship has been strained by misunderstandings and a month-long cold war, finally reconcile. The tension stemmed from Song Tae-won's belief that Sung Hyun-jae was having an affair (due to overheard whispers) and Sung Hyun-jae's secret efforts to commission a custom suit for Song Tae-won's birthday. After a period of emotional distance and physical injuries caused by their mutual distraction, they confront each other on Song Tae-won's birthday. The misunderstanding is cleared, leading to an intense and passionate reconciliation.

new_characters.name: Song Tae-won
new_characters.description: A stoic, rational, and highly competent individual who works long hours. He is deeply devoted to his partner, Sung Hyun-jae, but has been struggling with intense anxiety and jealousy due to perceived changes in their relationship.

new_characters.name: Sung Hyun-jae
new_characters.description: Song Tae-won's partner. He is an S-rank individual who has been acting unusually secretive, causing Song Tae-won to doubt their relationship. He was secretly preparing a birthday gift for Song Tae-won.
